First, 4 weeks + 7 days = 28 days + 7 days = 35 days.  
Subtract 35 days from 1661-10-22.  
October has 31 days, so 35 days before Oct 22:  
Oct 22 → Oct 1 is 21 days back, need 14 more days into September.  
September has 30 days, so Sept 30 → Sept 17 is 14 days back.  

Result: 1661-09-17.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1661-09-17
